method: Same 9000 fixed clips and frozen model decision rules. Primary results use training-consistent Part 2 preparation and fresh embeddings; the original raw Part 2 protocol is retained separately.
cache_regeneration: Use the 20261023 prepare_clips.py and reproduce.py scripts with the original CUDA bfloat16 settings. Regenerated archives must match the recorded hashes; otherwise document a new extraction rather than claiming exact cache identity.

preprocessing_correction.reason: Original Part 2 evaluation bypassed training/MVP loudness normalization. Historical raw-input results are now kept as a separate stress test.
preprocessing_correction.audio_preparation: 16 kHz mono; 25 ms frame RMS silence trimming, 10 ms hop, -40 dB relative threshold, 100 ms padding; target RMS -20 dBFS, peak limit 0.99; PCM16 FLAC quantization/decode.
preprocessing_correction.duration_policy: All 3000 trimmed clips are within 3-6 seconds; no exclusions or cropping.
preprocessing_correction.fusion_preparation: Both acoustic features and Whisper embeddings freshly extracted from trimmed/normalized/quantized waveforms; original raw embeddings are used only for historical results.
